body.intent: Fix the usage governor's limits are wrong for the account: one limit hit (2026-11-04 10:45Z) taught both the session and the weekly limit, so the weekly limit became that week's running total (21.9M) and held every run for a day though the week reached 85.8M with no weekly cap hit; learned limits never relearn after a plan upgrade (the owner moved to Max 20x); and usageHoldOf counts a live run's tokens twice (already in the window's used, and again as a full run mean). A hit must teach only the kind it hit, learned limits must move up when use passes them without a hit, and a live run's projection must count only its remaining expected tokens
